brief: A girl in Surat who fixes old radios wants her grandfather's silent radio to play again before Diwali.
Two flatmates fight over the last mango in the fridge, and both lose.
A night-shift security guard notices that the CCTV screens show tomorrow's date.
A delivery drone falls for the old lighthouse it passes every night.
A 60-second ad for a solar lantern that lets a village girl study after dark.
A shy boy takes his grandmother's recipe to the school cooking contest.
मुंबई की लोकल ट्रेन में दो अजनबी एक खोया हुआ बटुआ उसके मालिक तक लौटाने निकलते हैं।
અમદાવાદની પોળમાં ઉતરાયણ પહેલાં એક દાદી અને તેની પૌત્રી તૂટેલો પતંગ સાંધે છે.
